## Notes

Release 2017-08-01; Survival mode deletes the save on death; hunger, thirst, fatigue, and cold; every action costs calories; wolves, bears, and other wildlife; hypothermia, frostbite, and dysentery; 12 regions; Wintermute story mode without permadeath.
